title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics autosuggest improvements
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: on-call engineers frequently need quick, relevant runbook suggestions and diagnostics context during incidents. The incident-bot autosuggest feature was returning noisy or low-recall candidates and lacked ranking signals from recent incident context. This PR improves suggestion relevance and stability by (1) adding new scoring signals derived from SLO/alert fingerprints and recent incident tags, (2) integrating a lightweight re-ranker that boosts runbooks with recent successful resolutions, (3) throttling noisy suggestions under high-alert churn, and (4) adding feature flag + migration to roll out progressively. The description below is a single continuous string summarizing changes, tests, and rollout plan. Changes include code, docs, tests, and telemetry updates. Rollout: behind feature flag `autosuggest-enhanced`; opt-in for SRE teams, monitor MTTI and suggestion CTR metrics, automatic rollback if error rate > 0.5% or negative CTR delta > 10%.

review_comments: Samir Gupta: Overall looks good. A couple of concerns: the re-ranker introduces a new dependency chain — can we keep it lightweight and avoid a heavy ML model for now? Also suggest adding a safety timeout to the re-ranker to avoid p95 tail amplification.

Maya Patel: Responding — re-ranker is rule-based with simple lexical features and a small recent-success table; no heavy model. Added a 50ms soft timeout with graceful fallback to baseline suggestions (see commit 3).
Elena Rossi: Please ensure throttling has clear metrics so SRE can detect over-suppression of useful runbooks. Also add a knob for minimum suggestions to always return during incidents.
Maya Patel: Added autosuggest.min_suggestions feature flag and exported autosuggest.throttle_suppressed_count metric. Updated tests to cover minimum suggestion behavior.
Jonah Lee: CI flaked on e2e once; re-ran and all checks passed. Approving pending tiny doc tweak.
Maya Patel: Fixed doc wording and added a short troubleshooting section for false positives. Thanks for the review.
release_notes:
- Improve incident-bot autosuggest relevance by adding incident-context scoring signals and a lightweight re-ranker.
- Add throttling/backpressure under alert churn to reduce noisy suggestions.
- Feature-flagged rollout: autosuggest-enhanced.
- New telemetry: autosuggest.ctr, autosuggest.latency, autosuggest.rollback_rate.
- Docs updated with on-call guidance and troubleshooting.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag `autosuggest-enhanced` for a small set of SRE teams initially. Watch autosuggest.ctr and autosuggest.rollback_rate for regressions. The re-ranker has a 50ms soft timeout and falls back to baseline suggestions. If error rate > 0.5% or CTR drops by >10%, rollback recommended.
changelog_entry: pr-82001: incident-bot autosuggest enhancements (scoring, re-ranker, throttling, telemetry)
testing_summary: Unit tests cover new signal extraction and throttling. E2E tests simulate high-alert churn and ensure minimum suggestions behavior. Integration tests validated feature-flag fallback and telemetry emission.
deploy_plan: Deploy behind feature flag. Canary to 5% of SRE team traffic for 24h, evaluate autosuggest.ctr and rollback_rate, then ramp 25% -> 100% over one week if metrics stable.
internal_notes: This addresses recurring oncall feedback collected in SRE-87 and reduces time-to-runbook for common database outage signals. Follow-up work: persist recent-resolution scores for cross-incident ranking (ENG-1504).
